title: BHASA: A Holistic Southeast Asian Linguistic and Cultural Evaluation Suite for Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the zero-shot performance of large language models on Southeast Asian languages (Indonesian, Vietnamese, Thai, Tamil) using an 8-task NLP benchmark and a handcrafted linguistic diagnostic toolkit (LINDSEA) that tests syntax, semantics, and pragmatics.

Assessing cultural representation through knowledge retrieval and generation tasks related to local proverbs, literature, history, and customs, as well as evaluating cultural sensitivity by having human raters score model responses to culturally sensitive scenarios.

As part of the cultural sensitivity evaluation, prompting models with sensitive scenarios related to gender issues (such as female-to-male transition in an Indonesian context) and having human raters evaluate the social appropriateness and helpfulness of the responses.
